headline: The stair is walked, not fallen
lede: Lemmings got sloped descents: one-cell drops are stepped in walk state, two-cell drops get a spanned plank road — and SPIRE's attract now builds that road live, parachute intact.
notes: #3920 merged 1393bbf — step-down mirrors the one-tile mount (walk state kept, zero fallDist); builders span 2-cell drops at the lower level, 3-row and water still refuse; candidates() mirrors so the HUD never lies.
SPIRE's carved shoulder re-opens the one certifiable airborne moment the walked stair had erased — the canopy demo pin (#3853) stays honest and the span shows itself in the attract.
lemcheck 333→338, --mutate 360/360, hand mutants all bleed (step-down, span, candidate mirror); prod proof: stepdown in assets/Lemmings-Dd08rwyt.js.
SSX manuals (#3905) landed earlier this window — land a scoring trick holding down, release clean for a chain-scaled manual.
